# Memory (looms)

29 calls. Every request needs the `Authorization` header: see [the overview](../index.md).

## `looms.create`

```http
PUT /looms
```

Creates a loom.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms).

**Request body:** [`LoomCreateRequest`](../types/loom-create-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | The loom's name, unique within its namespace. |
| `namespaceId` | `uuid` | yes | The namespace to create it in. |
| `description` | `string \| null` |  | What the loom is for, in your own words. |
| `settings` | [`LoomSettingsInput`](../types/loom-settings.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | Night weaving, quiet period and weaver model. Absent: the defaults. |

**Response:** [`Loom`](../types/loom.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/looms" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"...","namespaceId":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const loom = await mt.looms.create({ name: "support-memory", namespaceId: "b5f3d1a9-7e6c-4b4a-9a2e-8c0d1f3e5a7b" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.create(name="support-memory", namespace_id="0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8776-655443322110", description="What the support agents learn")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `looms.delete`

```http
DELETE /looms/by-id/{id}
```

Unravels (erases) a loom and everything in it (Tenant.Admin).

**Who can call it:** Tenant admins only, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=DELETE%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Response:** no body (204)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X DELETE "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH"
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.delete("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e");
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.delete("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f")
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `looms.update`

```http
PATCH /looms/by-id/{id}
```

Changes a loom's name, description or settings (absent fields are unchanged).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PATCH%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`LoomUpdateRequest`](../types/loom-update-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string \| null` |  | Absent keeps the current name, as does the loom's own name sent back unchanged. |
| `description` | `string \| null` |  | Absent keeps the current description; an empty string clears it. |
| `settings` | [`LoomSettingsInput`](../types/loom-settings.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | Absent keeps the current settings. |

**Response:** [`Loom`](../types/loom.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PATCH "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"...","description":"...","settings":{}}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.update("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e", { description: "What support agents learn about customers" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.update("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f", description="What the support desk has learnt")
```

## `looms.shapePattern`

```http
PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/patterns/by-name/{codebase}
```

Changes a codebase's pattern (adds or removes heuristics, key files, conventions).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fpatterns%2Fby-name%2F%7Bcodebase%7D).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |
| `codebase` | `string` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`PatternChange`](../types/pattern-change.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `architecture` | `string \| null` |  | Replaces how the codebase is built, in a few sentences; an empty string clears it. Null leaves it as it is. |
| `addHeuristics` | `string[]` |  | Heuristics to add: how to find your way around the codebase. |
| `addKeyFiles` | `string[]` |  | Key files to add: entry points and the files that explain the rest. |
| `addConventions` | `string[]` |  | Conventions to add: style, patterns, rules. |
| `remove` | `string[]` |  | Items to drop, matched case-insensitively against the start of an item's text. |

**Response:** [`LoomPattern`](../types/loom-pattern.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>/patterns/by-name/<codebase>" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"architecture":"...","addHeuristics":[],"addKeyFiles":[],"addConventions":[],"remove":[]}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.shapePattern("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e", "acme/web-app", { addConventions: ["Feature folders, one component per file"], addHeuristics: [], addKeyFiles: [], remove: [] });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.shape_pattern("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f", "acme/app", add_conventions=["Services own all business logic"])
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `looms.seed`

```http
PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/seed
```

Seeds this loom from another (`fromLoomId`, or `fromLoom` by name).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fseed).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`LoomSeedRequest`](../types/loom-seed-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fromLoomId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The source loom's id. |
| `fromLoom` | `string \| null` |  | The source loom's name, looked up in this loom's namespace, or `name@namespace` for a loom in another namespace (named by its id or its name). |
| `limit` | `integer \| null` |  | At most this many threads, strongest first. Absent: the most a seeding copies (200). |

**Response:** [`LoomSeeding`](../types/loom-seeding.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>/seed" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"fromLoomId":"...","fromLoom":"...","limit":0}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.seed("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e", { fromLoom: "company-handbook@shared" });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.seed("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f", from_loom="support-memory@demo", limit=50)
```

## `looms.weave`

```http
PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/threads
```

Weaves a thread in (or reinforces one it matches).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fthreads).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`ThreadWeaveRequest`](../types/thread-weave-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string` | yes | The thread's words: what to remember. |
| `kind` | [`ThreadKind`](../types/thread-kind.md)`\| null` |  | What kind of memory it is. Absent: `Semantic` (a fact). |
| `weight` | `number \| null` |  | How much it matters, 0 to 1. Absent: 0.6. |
| `foundational` | `boolean \| null` |  | True makes it warp (never frays); false forces weft. Absent: warp only for relational threads. |
| `decayRate` | [`DecayRate`](../types/decay-rate.md)`\| null` |  | How quickly it frays when unused. Absent: the default for its kind and strand. |
| `subjects` | `string[]` |  | Who or what it is about, as named in conversation. |
| `tags` | `string[]` |  | Free-form tags. |
| `private` | `boolean` |  | True makes it a private note, offered only to the agent that wove it; one woven through the API is offered to no agent. |
| `pinned` | `boolean` |  | True holds it close: always part of what an agent wakes up knowing. |
| `cues` | `string[] \| null` |  | Words (up to three each, at most 8) that bring the thread back when someone says them. |
| `replaces` | `uuid \| null` |  | A thread this one corrects or replaces: it is let go once this is woven, keeping what it said. |
| `until` | `datetime \| null` |  | When it stops holding (a deadline, a plan's day, a reminder that stops mattering); must be in the future. A bare day (`"2026-10-30"`) holds until that day is over, as it does for an agent's `LoomWeave` tool; a time with no zone is UTC. |
| `basis` | [`ThreadBasis`](../types/thread-basis.md)`\| null` |  | What it rests on: `Said` (default), `Impression` (a reading nobody said) or `Read` (from a document or tool). |

**Response:** [`WeaveResult`](../types/weave-result.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>/threads" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"content":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.weave("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e", { content: "Ada prefers e-mail to phone calls.", subjects: ["customer:C-1042"], tags: [], private: false, pinned: false });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.weave("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f", content="Refunds over $100 need a manager.", subjects=["refunds"])
```


Gives a thread to another loom (`toLoomId`, or `toLoom`: `"name"` or `"name@namespace"`).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fthreads%2Fby-id%2F%7BthreadId%7D%2Fgive).

## `looms.reframe`

```http
PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/threads/by-id/{threadId}/reframe
```

Rewrites a thread, with the reason.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Flooms%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fthreads%2Fby-id%2F%7BthreadId%7D%2Freframe).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |
| `threadId` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`ThreadReframeRequest`](../types/thread-reframe-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string \| null` |  | The thread's new words. Absent keeps them. |
| `weight` | `number \| null` |  | The thread's new weight, 0 to 1. Absent keeps it. |
| `foundational` | `boolean \| null` |  | True makes it warp (never frays); false makes it weft. Absent keeps its strand. |
| `reason` | `string` | yes | Why it changed. Kept on the seam the reframe leaves. |
| `acknowledgment` | `string \| null` |  | Required to revise a warp thread or to make a thread warp: the explicit acknowledgment that a foundation is changing. |
| `cues` | `string[] \| null` |  | Replaces the words the thread waits for; empty clears them; absent leaves them as they are. |

**Response:** [`LoomThread`](../types/loom-thread.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/looms/by-id/<id>/threads/by-id/<threadId>/reframe" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"reason":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.looms.reframe("2c9a7e5b-3d1f-4a8c-b6e4-9f0d2c1b3a5e", "7a5c3e1f-9b8d-4c6a-8e2f-1d3b5a7c9e0f", { content: "Ada prefers e-mail, never before 9am.", reason: "She asked again." });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.looms.reframe("5c6d7e8f-9a0b-4c1d-8e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f", "3c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-8e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f", reason="The limit changed", content="Refunds over $200 need a manager.")
```

```http
PUT /looms/by-id/{id}/threads/recall
```

The threads most relevant to a query.
